idea-plugin.name: Find in Commit History
idea-plugin.description:
Search your Git history for the commits that add or remove a string — the git log -S and git log -G ("pickaxe") search, inside your IDE.

  • Find where a string came from — type a string, get the list of commits that added or removed it, most recent first.
  • A line rewritten identically is not reported: only a real change in the number of occurrences is.
  • Regular expressions — match the diff itself with git log -G semantics.
  • Filter by path — restrict the search to the files you care about. Binary files are ignored.
  • Works with your own repository — the history is read locally, nothing is sent anywhere.

Free and Pro. The search itself stays free for everyone: -S/-G, the path filter and the hash copy. The Pro licence (29 $/year, personal) adds four things, on top of the free core — nothing is taken away from the free version:

  • Search the commit messages (--grep): find the commit that only mentioned the string.
  • Export the results: CSV, Markdown, or a list of patches to replay in a terminal.
  • Save your searches, per repository.
  • Search every repository open in the project at once.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Free and Pro. The free search does not change: it stays free for everyone, with no account and no telemetry. This version adds a Pro licence (29 $/year, personal, 14-day trial) that unlocks four extra features.

  • Search the commit messages (git log --grep): the search can now run on the commit messages, on the diffs, or on both.
  • Export the results: CSV, Markdown, or a list of git show commands to replay the selection in a terminal.
  • Save your searches: the last 10 searches are kept per repository, in the settings of your IDE.
  • Search every repository of the project at once, with the results grouped per repository.
  • The free core is unchanged: -S/-G, path filter, copy of the hash — still free, still local, still without an account.
